uplink.description: 0x49 TIC data (three-phase) — BASE energy, IINST1/2/3 currents, IMAX1/2/3, PMAX active power, PAPP apparent
uplink._note: Upstream codec example (tic-cbe-linky-tri-codec.yaml). expected.data derived by running reference/upstream-codec.js: BASE 0x1234=4660 Wh, IINST1 0x2B=43 A, IINST2 0x2C=44, IINST3 0x2D=45, IMAX1/2/3 17/18/19 A, PMAX 0x20=32 W, PAPP 0x10=16 VA. status byte 0x40 -> frameCounter 2, all flags false. IINST<N>/IMAX<N> are per-phase, so they ride in channels[] entries phaseA/phaseB/phaseC (power.current + maxCurrent); BASE/PMAX/PAPP/ADCO are whole-meter registers and stay top-level.

uplink.description: 0x49 TIC data — second sample with low-battery and config flags set
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds three-phase frame, cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js. BASE 0x000186A0=100000 Wh, IINST1/2/3 12/10/8 A, IMAX1/2/3 30/28/25 A, PMAX 0x0BB8=3000 W, PAPP 0x09C4=2500 VA. status 0x63 -> frameCounter 3, lowBattery+configurationDone true.

uplink.description: 0x49 TIC data — unbalanced three-phase load, distinct current and maximum per phase
uplink._note: Synthetic three-phase frame with a different value on every phase, so the channels[] entries cannot be confused with one another. Byte layout per reference/upstream-codec.js Tic0x49Parser (ticCbeLinkyTri branch): ADCO 2..13 = "031122334455", BASE 14 = 0x0003D090 = 250000 Wh, IINST1/2/3 at 18/22/26 = 21/18/15 A, IMAX1/2/3 at 30/34/38 = 33/31/29 A, PMAX 42 = 0x11F8 = 4600 W, PAPP 46 = 0x12C0 = 4800 VA. status 0x40 -> frameCounter 2.

uplink.description: 0x49 TIC data — phase C absent on the TIC bus and phase B's IMAX absent (0x80000000 sentinels)
uplink._note: Sentinel policy vector. IINST3 and IMAX3 both carry the upstream not-found sentinel 0x80000000, so phase C produces no channels[] entry at all; IMAX2 is also absent, so phase B's entry carries only power.current. BASE 0x00015662 = 87650 Wh, PMAX 0x0834 = 2100 W, PAPP 0x0898 = 2200 VA.

uplink.description: 0x49 TIC data with BASE register absent (sentinel 0x80000000) — emits warning, still satisfies power-meter via per-phase current/active

warnings: no cumulative energy index on the TIC bus (BASE absent)

uplink._note: BASE set to the upstream not-found sentinel 0x80000000 so no metering.energy.total is emitted; warning declared. IINST1/2/3 15/14/13 A -> per-phase power.current, PMAX 0x40=64 W -> power.active, PAPP 0x32=50 VA. Confirmed reg32 returns null on sentinel.
Frame code 0x99 is not one of the normalized Adeunis TIC frames (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x49/0x4a), so decodeUplinkCore returns an error.
